title: The retellings of "The Pear Film" by preschoolers, primary school students, and high school students

description.en: The dataset comprises video recordings of retellings of "The Pear Film" (W. Chafe, 1975)  by preschoolers, primary school children, and high school students, along with data on the adaptors and gestures employed during the retelling process.
